stem.text: A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $12\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance is connected to a fixed resistor of resistance $40\,\Omega$ and a thermistor of resistance $R_\text{T}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a single loop containing a battery labelled 12 V, a fixed resistor labelled 40 Ω and a thermistor labelled R_T, drawn in series.

stem.text: Initially, the temperature of the thermistor is $15\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ and the current in the circuit is $0.10\,\text{A}$.
The temperature of the thermistor then changes, which causes the current to increase to $0.12\,\text{A}$.
How does the temperature of the thermistor change and what is $R_\text{T}$ at the new temperature?
